`solve_model` passes `self._window.model_index`, but that window is stored on the network, not on the model being solved. If a network builds a flat model, then builds a MultiIndex model and restores the earlier model, the retained window describes the second build, so `extra_functionality` receives a MultiIndex for the flat model. The diff does not validate or restore the window when the model changes.
